claims.text: Tác phẩm có thật, tên: Diễn từ (Discourses)

sources.quote: The major compilation of Epictetus’s teaching is the work standardly referred to in English as the Discourses; it was variously titled in antiquity.

claims.text: Tác giả: Epictetus (epictetus), qua bản ghi của Arrian

sources.quote: According to their preface, the Discourses are not the writing of Epictetus but are ghostwritten by the essayist and historiographer Arrian of Nicomedia
two works composed by his student Arrian, the Discourses and the Handbook

claims.text: attribution: Arrian ghi lại lời dạy của Epictetus

sources.quote: the Discourses are not the writing of Epictetus but are ghostwritten by the essayist and historiographer Arrian of Nicomedia
Our knowledge of his philosophy and his method as a teacher comes to us via two works composed by his student Arrian, the Discourses and the Handbook.

notes: SEP: 'The work we have is in four books, or volumes, but the original work comprised eight or more books' (khớp câu văn trang dùng). Tác giả quy ước là Epictetus, Arrian ghi lại; có thể thêm ghi chú attribution. Không có năm để kiểm. Kiểm lại 5.1b: attribution đúng. SEP thêm rằng một số học giả (Dobbin 1998) cho Epictetus tự soạn; quan điểm chính vẫn là Arrian ghi.
